summary: Q&A platform losing its core use case to AI that answers the same questions better, faster, and for free.
moat: Quora's historical moat was a corpus of high-quality expert answers accumulated over 15 years, with strong Google SEO that channeled search traffic into its question-answer format. Its Poe AI platform represents a pivot attempt. The core threat is existential: the primary reason anyone visited Quora — to get a good answer to a question — is now handled better by ChatGPT and Perplexity.

challengers.name: ChatGPT and Perplexity AI
challengers.evidence: Perplexity AI reached 100 million monthly users by early 2025, providing cited, real-time answers to the exact query types that drove the majority of Quora's search traffic.
